dataset.name: CICIDS2018 development with CIC-IDS2017 external evaluation

threshold_policy.selection_rule: Choose the highest validation threshold that meets both targets. The fixed cross-dataset comparison threshold is 0.26.

candidate_hypothesis: A fixed 29-feature schema shared by CICIDS2018 and CIC-IDS2017 can preserve low-alert attack detection while enabling documented cross-dataset evaluation.
evaluation_protocol: Use CICIDS2018 train_data.csv only for candidate cross-validation and configuration decisions.
Use CIC-IDS2017 labels only after the V14 configuration and threshold are frozen.
Report CIC-IDS2017 performance as cross-dataset evaluation, not as a pristine blind holdout, because its feature schema was inspected to establish compatibility.
notes: V14 removes only Protocol from V13's 30-feature schema because CIC-IDS2017 CSV exports do not provide it.
This is a candidate specification, not a trained artifact or a release.
